patch.summary:
Choose NiceJob only if your buying job matches “Reputation and review management for local businesses — affiliate partner.” rather than Tidio's shape. Choose Tidio only if your buying job matches “Live chat and AI messaging — Starter $24.17/mo annual (100 billable convos); Growth from $” rather than NiceJob's shape. Workflow advantage: NiceJob leans reputation-reviews, review-generation; Tidio leans live-chat-support, ai-customer-service. Trade-off: you gain focus on one product's motion at the cost of the other's adjacent coverage — no universal winner.

Major differences:
- Positioning: NiceJob is Reputation and review management for local businesses — affiliate partner.; Tidio is Live chat and AI messaging — Starter $24.17/mo annual (100 billable convos); Growth from $49.17. Primary live-chat; CS secondary..
- Company-size focus: NiceJob (micro, small-business) vs Tidio (micro, small-business, mid-market).
- Workflow coverage skew: NiceJob-leaning reputation-reviews, review-generation, local-reputation vs Tidio-leaning live-chat-support, ai-customer-service.
- Researched limits: NiceJob — Adjacent to CS — reputation/review generation, not helpdesk or live chat; Tidio — Conversation-cap pricing — high traffic sites need Growth+ tiers.

Limitations — NiceJob: Adjacent to CS — reputation/review generation, not helpdesk or live chat; Per-location licensing multiplies cost for multi-branch operators; Tidio: Conversation-cap pricing — high traffic sites need Growth+ tiers; Not a full helpdesk/ITSM — thin ticketing vs Freshdesk.
